Research the following and cite real, verifiable sources:

Research the real, publicly available API rate limits and pricing tiers for The Odds API (the-odds-api.com) as of 2026. Cite the actual page you found this on.

If you're not sure about something, just say so.
response:
As of 2026, The Odds API operates on a credit-based pricing model rather than a simple "requests per month" system. Here are the verified details from their official documentation:

## Rate Limits
The API enforces a rate limit of **30 requests per second** across all paid plans. When exceeded, the API returns HTTP status code 429 (Too Many Requests) to protect against sudden traffic bursts.

Source: [The Odds API - Rate Limit Guide](https://the-odds-api.com/guide/rate-limit.html)

## Pricing Tiers (2026)
The Odds API currently offers three self-serve subscription tiers:

| Tier | Price | Monthly Credits | Key Features |
|------|-------|----------------|--------------|
| **Free** | $0 | 500 | All sports, most bookmakers, all betting markets, and historical odds (credit costs apply per request based on markets/regions queried) |
| **Professional** | $29/month | 20,000 | 25+ sports including NBA, NFL, MLB, NHL, soccer leagues; h2h, spreads, and totals markets; US sportsbooks (DraftKings, FanDuel, BetMGM, Caesars, etc.) |
| **Business** | $99/month | 200,000 | Everything in Professional plus 50+ international books (UK, EU, AU regions), Pinnacle (sharp anchor), player props (NBA, NHL, MLB, WNBA, AFL, NRL), futures markets, and historical odds archive access |

Sources: [The Odds API Homepage](https://theoddsapi.com/) and [API Betting - The Odds API Review](https://www.apibetting.com/providers/the-odds-api)

## Usage Credit System
- **Credit Costs**: One API call to `/odds/?sport_key=...` returns all tracked bookmakers and markets for that sport, but the credit cost varies depending on how many markets and regions are queried.
- **Monitoring**: Current usage is tracked via HTTP response headers: `x-requests-remaining`, `x-requests-used`, and `x-requests-last`.
- **Reset Cycle**: Usage credits automatically reset on the first day of every month. Paid plans bill monthly on the same calendar date the subscription started.

Source: [The Odds API - API Error Codes](https://the-odds-api.com/liveapi/guides/v4/api-error-codes.html) and [The Odds API FAQs](https://the-odds-api.com/manage/faqs.html)

**Note on discrepancies**: Some third-party aggregator sites may still reference older "requests per day" limits (e.g., "25 requests/day" for free tiers). The 500-credit/month model represents the current 2026 structure as documented in The Odds API's official pricing page and developer documentation.
